answer: Proposal: each ID/day supplies a seed for jetty and reef inspection sampling using 1 million sequential VDF squarings of a fresh ID/day-bound registry nonce. The registry verifies nonce, output and proof; failure denies that day's listing. Assuming independent-work hardness, ten IDs need 10 million squarings; a parallel thread cannot reuse another ID's proof. Electricity recurs; CPUs are reusable capital; no stake. A setup trapdoor or shortcut breaks the cost claim; faster hardware cheapens IDs. This meters work, not owners.
